comment: Item catalogue: per Item id, its greybox shape (catalogue.json 'items'), carry_speed (scales the carrier's walk and dash, default 1.0), tilt_to_camera (tilted toward the camera while carried, for cards) and frequency_stripe (the shape's 'identity' part is drawn in the Item's frequency colour). Shifts place Items on Counters by id in 'counter_items'; Transforms in stations.json name them. 'placeholder' is kept for test fixtures.
